premises.text: Data-rich stool and urine can provide valuable health insights
premises.evidence_span: Data-rich stool and urine. It's absolute gold, yet it's flushed away every day.

premises.text: Truloo is the first commercially available toilet seat that optically scans output
premises.evidence_span: Truloo is the world's first and only commercially available toilet seat that optically scans your output.

premises.text: Senior communities benefit from using Truloo as it reduces manual tracking by nurses
premises.evidence_span: More than 40 senior communities across the country have installed Truloo's. And nurses love it because they no longer have to toilet talk and manually track the residents.

premises.text: AI can improve its analysis of stool and urine with more data from toilet sessions
premises.evidence_span: We've analyzed more than 1.2 million toilet sessions. And with each additional plop, we are able to train our AI to be better and better at discerning things like what color red is in the stool?

premises.text: Truloo offers a more convenient health monitoring solution compared to wearable devices
premises.evidence_span: This is far more convenient. You don't need to recharge it. You don't need to wear it.

premises.text: Truloo is positioned as a leader in the emerging market for personal health monitoring
premises.evidence_span: A lot of companies would be happy to be number two in a market. We are number one in the next frontier for personal health.

value.text: Health monitoring becomes more accessible and less intrusive through Truloo
